_what: THE ONE MASTER for the Texas Capitol's measured dimensions. frontend/tests/capitol-model.test.mjs reads THIS file and holds the deck's drawn geometry to it, so the numbers are stated once, with their source, and a drift in either carrier fails. Added at r.208 (operator 2026-10-13: 'enhance capital of texas using online images to make more realistic outline').
_honesty: Outbound HTTP is blocked in the build container, so these figures came through search synthesis of the cited pages rather than from opening the primary documents. Each entry says how it was obtained. A gate built on them catches LATER drift; it cannot catch a wrong original, and saying so is the point of this file.
frame: metres · +X east · +Y up · +Z south in the deck; the arena record is +X east / +Y north, so deck z = -(record y)
